title: Valid Parentheses
prompt: Given a string `s` containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid. A string is valid if brackets are closed by the same type of bracket and in the correct order.
constraints: s consists only of bracket characters '()[]{}'.
hints: A stack is a natural fit here — think about what needs to happen when you see a closing bracket.
Push opening brackets onto a stack; on a closing bracket, check if it matches the top of the stack.
Don't forget to check the stack is empty at the very end.
